issues.detail: The Vietnamese 'ngăn trở ý định đó' (obstructed that intention) incorrectly attributes the action of stopping to the centurion. The Greek 'εκωλυσεν αυτους του βουληματος' means he 'hindered them [the soldiers] from [his] will/intention' (i.e., he stopped the soldiers from carrying out his own plan to save Paul). The Vietnamese phrasing makes it sound like someone else stopped the centurion's intention.

The Greek 'βουλομενος διασωσαι τον παυλον' (wanting to save Paul) is omitted in the Vietnamese translation. The Vietnamese only mentions his desire to save Paul as a reason for the subsequent action, but fails to clearly link that he was the one who wanted to do it.
